title: When the Orbit Turns
premise: Mara Nystrom, a nonbinary insurance investigator who insures the shipping lanes between two estranged human colonies, answers a distress call broadcast in Old Meridian — a language extinct since the colonies' bitter split. The signal is a forgery, planted by a found-family crew of smugglers who need an official witness to legitimize their desperate gambit: convincing both fleets that a third party is provoking war. As Mara falls for the forger, Sefa, and the lie begins to collapse under fleet scrutiny, they must choose between exposing the truth and letting the deception stand. In the end, Mara testifies to a half-truth that keeps the fleets apart but costs them their license and their old identity — and chooses, finally, the family and love they built in the gap between worlds.
about_author: Ivo Montrose is the pen name of a former maritime claims adjuster who traded harbor offices for deep-space fiction after a career spent documenting other people's disasters. They write about people who keep systems running from the margins, and live somewhere with unreliable weather and excellent radio.

chapters.title: The Long Route
chapters.summary: POV: Mara. Between insurance runs on the silent corridor separating the colonies of Vesper and Calloway, Mara investigates a 'impossible' collision that both governments blame on each other. A smuggler crew led by the magnetic Sefa hires them as a neutral witness. The beat: loneliness established, curiosity kindled — Mara agrees to one job, telling themselves it's just work.

chapters.title: A Language Nobody Speaks
chapters.summary: POV: Mara, with a Sefa interlude. The crew broadcasts a distress call in extinct Old Meridian; both fleets scramble, each convinced the other attacked a ghost ship. Mara realizes the forgery's purpose — a manufactured common enemy — and, horrified, also realizes only their testimony can make it hold. The beat: complicity. Mara stays not for duty but because Sefa's conviction — and warmth — has become impossible to walk away from.

chapters.title: What the Fleets Believe
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Mara and Sefa. A Callowayan admiral demands Mara verify evidence that doesn't exist, while a Vespers mole inside the crew threatens exposure. Sefa confesses the plan began as revenge for her brother, killed in the split's last skirmish. Mara and Sefa argue love against duty as the mole transmits proof of the hoax. The beat: rising dread — the lie is cracking, and so are they.

chapters.title: When the Orbit Turns
chapters.summary: POV: Mara. At the joint inquiry, with the mole's evidence minutes from detonating both fleets into war, Mara testifies to a crafted half-truth: a rogue faction, now destroyed, provoked both sides — plausible enough to give each fleet an off-ramp. The fleets stand down; Mara loses their license and their old name, and gains a crew, a home, and Sefa. The beat: sacrifice resolved into belonging.
